desc:
Ever wondered if you have what it takes to turn rusty wrecks into legendary cars, build a car empire from scratch and drive your dream vehicle?

Welcome to CAR FLIPPER!
Start with a broken-down vehicle and turn it into something incredible. Buy damaged cars, repair them and customize them. Will you keep them in your collection or sell them for a profit? The choice is yours!

With 100+ unique vehicles and hundreds of customization options, every car can become a bestseller. Upgrade them, install performance parts and create cars that match your style.

What awaits you?
🔧 Restore and Repair 
🚘 Collect and Customize
⚙️ Upgrade Performance
🎨 Personalize Your Cars
 🏙 Explore a Massive World
🏢 Expand Your Workshop
🏁 Race Your Friends

Will you become a master mechanic, a successful car dealer or the owner of the ultimate car collection?

Start your journey today and discover what awaits beyond the garage doors!
